info.name: kensa-teamcity-plugin
info.description:
Surfaces Kensa BDD test reports inside TeamCity.
Three features, all behind a single opt-in build feature:
• Kensa Report tab — embeds the Kensa HTML site as a per-build tab with an "Open in new tab" link for full-page rendering. • First-class test results — each Kensa test surfaces in TeamCity's Tests UI by its human-readable Given-When-Then display name, joining the standard history graphs, flaky-test detection, and trends. • Failure summaries — when a Kensa test fails, the Given-When-Then narrative + captured values + exception is attached inline as the test's failure detail in the Tests tab — exactly where you land when triaging a red build.
Frictionless: drop in the build feature, run a build that produces Kensa output, and all three surfaces light up. No paths to configure for the common single-sourceset case.
Source: https://github.com/kensa-dev/teamcity-plugin Kensa: https://github.com/kensa-dev/kensa
